what.text: A sequence diagram shows the messages between participants, in time order, from top to bottom.

lifeline.text: Each participant is a lifeline: a head box, with a dashed line going down.

exec.text: While a participant is busy, a thin bar appears on its line: the execution, also called activation.

msg.text: Messages are arrows between lifelines. Each one has a sender and a receiver.

frag.text: Combined fragments are boxes with an operator in the corner.

alt.text: alt: alternatives. If this, else that.

opt.text: opt: an option. It happens, or nothing happens.

brk.text: break: do this instead of the rest. In the login example, after more than three failed attempts, break ends the process.

ref.text: And ref, an interaction use, calls another diagram, so big diagrams stay simple.

destroy.text: Finally, an X at the bottom of a lifeline is a destruction occurrence: that participant is gone.
